tool_proficiencies: one artisan's tools or musical instrument

1.name: Martial Arts
1.description: Scaling unarmed/monk-weapon die (d4->d6->d8->d10); can use DEX instead of STR; bonus-action unarmed strike after the Attack action.

1.name: Unarmored Defense (Monk)
1.description: AC = 10 + DEX + WIS when not wearing armor or a shield.

2.name: Ki
2.description: Ki point pool (= monk level) fueling Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind.

2.name: Unarmored Movement
2.description: +10ft speed while unarmored, scaling with level.

2.name: Patient Defense
2.description: 1 ki, bonus action: Dodge. Not simulated -- overlaps with the tactical AI's retreat strategy.

2.name: Step of the Wind
2.description: 1 ki, bonus action: Disengage or Dash, double jump distance. Not simulated -- overlaps with kite strategy.

3.name: Monastic Tradition
3.description: Choose subclass. Non-combat in this sim except where a subclass feature is listed below.

3.name: Deflect Missiles
3.description: Reaction: reduce damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10+DEX+monk level.

4.name: Slow Fall
4.description: Reduce falling damage by 5x monk level. Non-combat in this sim.

5.name: Stunning Strike
5.description: 1 ki on hit: CON save or stunned until the end of your next turn.

6.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
6.description: Unarmed strikes count as magical. Non-combat in this sim (no magic-resistant monsters authored yet).

7.name: Evasion
7.description: No damage on a successful DEX save, half on a failed one. Not simulated for Monk yet -- shares the Rogue/Ranger Evasion feature name but not wired to this class.

7.name: Stillness of Mind
7.description: End your own charmed/frightened condition as an action. Non-combat in this sim.

9.name: Unarmored Movement Improvement
9.description: Move along vertical surfaces/across liquids. Non-combat in this sim.

10.name: Purity of Body
10.description: Immune to disease and poison. Non-combat in this sim.

13.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
13.description: Understand and be understood by all creatures. Non-combat.

14.name: Diamond Soul
14.description: Proficiency in all saving throws; spend 1 ki to reroll a failed save. Not simulated -- would need a save-reroll hook symmetrical to Lucky's, deferred.

15.name: Timeless Body
15.description: Age much more slowly; no need for food or water. Non-combat.

18.name: Empty Body
18.description: Spend 4 ki: invisible for 1 minute. Not simulated -- would need an invisibility-application hook, deferred.

20.name: Perfect Self
20.description: Regain 4 ki if you have none left when you roll initiative. Non-combat in this sim.

3.name: Open Hand Technique
3.description: Flurry of Blows hits impose prone/push/no-reaction. Not simulated -- would need per-hit rider effects on Flurry, deferred.

6.name: Wholeness of Body
6.description: Action: heal 3x monk level HP once per long rest. Not simulated -- rest cycles aren't modeled mid-combat.

11.name: Tranquility
11.description: Sanctuary effect between long rests. Non-combat in this sim.

17.name: Quivering Palm
17.description: Ki-based delayed death effect. Not simulated -- deferred.

3.name: Shadow Arts
3.description: Spend 2 ki to cast Darkness/Darkvision/Pass without Trace/Silence. Not simulated -- deferred.

6.name: Shadow Step
6.description: Teleport between dim light/darkness with advantage on next attack. Not simulated -- deferred.

11.name: Cloak of Shadows
11.description: Become invisible in dim light/darkness. Not simulated -- deferred.

17.name: Opportunist
17.description: Reaction attack when an ally hits a creature within 5ft. Not simulated -- deferred.

3.name: Disciple of the Elements
3.description: Spend ki on elemental spell-like attacks (Fangs of the Fire Snake, Water Whip, etc.). Not simulated -- deferred; this subclass functions as a plain monk in this sim.
